item.title: Core Concepts MOC
item.description:
Core Concepts MOC

This Map of Content (MOC) serves as a central hub for fundamental technical concepts in distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture.

Distributed Systems

  • [[CAP Theorem]] - Understanding the trade-offs between Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance
  • [[Consistency Models]] - Strong, eventual, and causal consistency
  • [[Partitioning and Sharding]] - Strategies for distributing data across multiple nodes

Microservices Architecture

  • [[Service Discovery]] - How services find and communicate with each other
  • [[API Gateways]] - Central entry point for client applications
  • [[Circuit Breakers]] - Handling failures gracefully in distributed systems

Event-Driven Architecture

  • [[Event Sourcing]] - Using events as the source of truth
  • [[CQRS]] - Command Query Responsibility Segregation
  • [[Message Brokers]] - Understanding message queues and pub/sub systems

Key Concepts by Topic

Distributed Systems Fundamentals

  • Consensus Algorithms
  • Distributed Transactions
  • Replication Strategies
  • Failure Detection
  • Clock Synchronization

Microservices Patterns

  • Service Mesh
  • Backend for Frontend (BFF)
  • Bulkhead Pattern
  • Sidecar Pattern
  • Database per Service

Event-Driven Patterns

  • Event-Driven Integration
  • Event Streaming
  • Event Sourcing
  • Saga Pattern
  • Outbox Pattern

Related MOCs

  • [[020-Technologies MOC]] - Specific technologies implementing these concepts
  • [[030-Repositories MOC]] - Code examples and implementations
  • [[040-Projects MOC]] - Projects utilizing these concepts

Resources and References
